title: Pre-Hardmode
summary: From spawn to the Wall of Flesh. Build a base, gear up, clear early bosses, and prepare to enter Hardmode.

bosses.name: King Slime
bosses.note: Optional but easy early loot (Slime Staff, Royal Gel).

bosses.name: Eye of Cthulhu
bosses.note: Summon at night with a Suspicious Looking Eye.

bosses.name: Eater of Worlds / Brain of Cthulhu
bosses.note: Corruption or Crimson world-evil boss.

bosses.name: Queen Bee
bosses.note: Optional, found in Jungle Bee hives; great pre-Skeletron loot.

bosses.name: Skeletron
bosses.note: Required to enter the Dungeon. Talk to Old Man at night.

bosses.name: Deerclops
bosses.note: Optional, summon with Deer Thing in snow/ice biome (console/mobile origin boss, now on all platforms).

bosses.name: Wall of Flesh
bosses.note: Summon in The Underworld with a Guide Voodoo Doll. Triggers Hardmode on kill!

npcs: Arms Dealer (after a gun is found)
Tavernkeep (after finding Etherian Manaweave / DD2 items)
money: Aim to have a few gold banked before Skeletron for Nurse healing / reforges
Sell unneeded ores, gems, and monster drops rather than hoarding
Fish up crates for early bonus loot and coins
optional: Build NPC housing early to unlock more shops sooner
Full Obsidian farm before Wall of Flesh (Obsidian Skull/Charm + lava)
Explore the Dungeon lightly before Skeletron dies (careful of strong enemies)
Fish for pre-Hardmode crates
Get a Life Fruit if by some fluke Jungle is already accessible (usually Hardmode-only in practice)

title: Early Hardmode
summary: Immediately after the Wall of Flesh through the three Mechanical Bosses.

bosses.name: Queen Slime
bosses.note: Optional, summon with Gelatin Crystal on the Hallow's surface at night.

bosses.name: The Twins
bosses.note: One of the three Mechanical Bosses; summon with Mechanical Eye.

bosses.name: The Destroyer
bosses.note: Summon with Mechanical Worm.

bosses.name: Skeletron Prime
bosses.note: Summon with Mechanical Skull.

bosses.name: (Any 1 Mech Boss)
bosses.note: Only one is strictly required to progress, but all three drop Hallowed Bars needed for a full set.

npcs: Steampunker (after a Mechanical Boss is defeated)
Goblin Tinkerer (after defeating a Goblin Army, can happen pre-Hardmode too)
Wizard (after a Mechanical Boss is defeated)
Witch Doctor (after defeating Queen Bee, may already be present)
Truffle (after a floating island Mushroom biome is created, post-Hardmode surface)
money: Reforge accessories at the Goblin Tinkerer once affordable
Sell Hardmode ore surplus once you've picked your armor tier
Start saving for Chlorophyte-tier reforges ahead of Plantera
optional: Kill a Goblin Army for the Goblin Tinkerer if not already done
Farm the Hallow/Underground Hallow for Hallowed Bars from all 3 mech bosses
Start a Hardmode fishing pass for new crates and the Angler's Hardmode rewards
Unlock Truffle by creating a floating Mushroom biome
Farm Souls of Light/Night for crafting (Ichor, Cursed Flame gear)

title: Post-Mech Bosses → Plantera
summary: Gear up in Hallowed equipment, unlock Chlorophyte, and take on Plantera in the Jungle.

bosses.name: Plantera
bosses.note: Break a Plantera's Bulb in the Underground Jungle after all 3 mech bosses are dead.

npcs: Witch Doctor's Truffle housing (if not done already)
money: Chlorophyte is worth farming for both bars and Life Fruit access
Stock up on Hardmode potions (Ironskin, Regeneration, Swiftness) before the fight
optional: Eat all reachable Life Fruits in the Jungle for +max HP before this fight
Farm Plantera multiple times for Temple access materials and weapon drops
Unlock the Jungle Temple (requires a Plantera drop, the Temple Key)

title: Post-Plantera → Golem
summary: Clear the Jungle Temple, farm Turtle gear, and defeat Golem.

bosses.name: Golem
bosses.note: Fought inside the Lihzahrd Temple; needs a Lihzahrd Power Cell from the Temple's traps/chests.

npcs: (No new NPC tied directly to Golem, but Party Girl may appear if happiness conditions are met)
money: Sell surplus Temple trap materials and Lihzahrd Bricks farmed loot
Save for post-Golem reforges ahead of end-game gear
optional: Farm Turtle armor from Jungle Turtles once Chlorophyte armor is set
Start Duke Fishron farming (optional superboss, fishing in the Ocean with a Truffle Worm)
Farm Golem for Sun Stone / Eye of the Golem accessories

title: Post-Golem → Moon Lord
summary: Unlock the final pre-Moon Lord content: Old One's Army, Martian Madness, Lunar Events, and the Celestial Towers.

bosses.name: Duke Fishron
bosses.note: Optional superboss, strong loot including the Bubble Gun / Flairon materials.

bosses.name: Old One's Army (waves)
bosses.note: Optional Tavernkeep event, unlocks Betsy's Wings and DD2 gear.

bosses.name: Lunatic Cultist
bosses.note: Fought at the Dungeon entrance after all 3 mech bosses, Plantera, and Golem are dead.

bosses.name: Celestial Pillars (Solar/Vortex/Nebula/Stardust)
bosses.note: Defend during the Lunar Events after killing the Lunatic Cultist.

bosses.name: Moon Lord
bosses.note: Summon with Celestial Sigil after all 4 Pillars are destroyed.

npcs: Party Girl (happiness-based, may already be present)
money: Lunar Event fragments are valuable — bank a stock before crafting your endgame weapon
Buy Sniper Scope/other reforges before Moon Lord for QoL
optional: Martian Madness event (optional, unlocked after a Pillar event) for Xenopopper/Laser Machinegun
Frost Moon and Pumpkin Moon events for exclusive Halloween/Christmas seasonal loot
Farm Solar Eclipse for Deathbringer/Bladetongue-tier weapons
Full Ocean/ Dungeon post-Plantera loot cleanup before Moon Lord

title: Post-Moon Lord
summary: Endgame content after defeating Moon Lord.

bosses.name: Empress of Light
bosses.note: Optional superboss, summon with a Prismatic Lacewing near the Hallow in daytime.

bosses.name: Zenith / Best-in-slot farming
bosses.note: Farm remaining superbosses and events for full completion.

money: Economy mostly irrelevant at this point — focus on drop farming instead
optional: Farm the Empress of Light for Terraprisma / accessories
Complete the Bestiary and Fishing quest log for the Angler / Zoologist rewards
Chase full achievements / Journey Mode Research completion if playing that mode
Farm for cosmetic vanity sets and pets
